text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen is here. In a matter of moments, the Empress, Air Groove, will face off against the Otherworldly Front Runner, Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd can scarcely wait for the epic contest to finally begin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When the two rivals come face to face, they exchange only a few brief words before making their way to the track.
